subject: Observability add-ons pricing — retention tiers, tracing seat reallocation, and dashboard swap
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@brightpet.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons — need pricing scenarios for retention + tracing

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We liked the dashboard UX and the low-latency traces, but procurement asked for concrete pricing scenarios before we move to a PO. Two asks from BrightPet: 

1) Retention options: we want a clear delta between 30 / 90 / 365 day retention for traces and metrics — and the estimated monthly cost given our current volume (~1.6TB/day ingest, ~2.8M trace spans/day).

2) Tracing seats: we have 8 active SREs but only 4 dedicated tracing seats in our current plan. We'd like a cost-effective way to let 8 SREs see traces without doubling the per-seat list price (consider seat swap or a view-only seat option).

3) Dashboards: we may want a separate advanced dashboard pack for ops (10 editors, 25 viewers) — please include one-time onboarding cost if applicable.

Also, procurement flagged that any onboarding credit or discount should be limited to the first 6 months and documented in the SOW. Can you provide two alternative proposals: 
A) conservative (minimal discount, favors metered retention) and 
B) aggressive (6-month onboarding credit + 20% bundle discount if we commit 12 months).

Can you send a single PDF with the scenarios + a short spreadsheet for their finance team? Procurement is on a tight timeline — they asked for numbers by end of day Friday.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Turner
Director of Platform Engineering, BrightPet Health

[Attachment: sample-volume-report.csv (csv)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@brightpet.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — need pricing scenarios for retention + tracing

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a concise package that covers both conservative and aggressive paths (PDF) plus a spreadsheet with line-item math. High level summary below; full detail is in the attachment.

Quick summary (monthly recurring, USD):
- Conservative: Retention tiering (30d default): $6,200/mo; 90d: $13,800/mo; 365d: $37,400/mo. Tracing seats: add 4 editor seats at $150/seat/mo, add 4 view-only seats at $25/seat/mo. Advanced dashboards pack (10 editors / 25 viewers): one-time onboarding $4,000 + $1,800/mo. No onboarding credit.

- Aggressive (12mo commit + onboarding concessions): 6-month onboarding credit equal to $12,000 applied across first two invoices; 20% bundle discount on addons for first 12 months. Effective first-year blended cost reduces initial three-month burn by ~22%. Also propose a view-only seat model (4 editors + 4 view-only) with bulk discount for the first year.

Notes and constraints:
- The 365d retention numbers assume warm storage on SSD-backed nodes and incremental cold snapshots to object store; cold egress is priced separately and is in the spreadsheet.
- View-only seats cannot access advanced query editing; if any SREs need write access we recommend editor seats.
- Onboarding credit requires signature on SOW (DocuSign) and a 12-month minimum term for the aggressive path.

I'm looping in Jordan and Rishi for final sign-off on margin and concession limits. Attached: OBS_PRICING_PKG_v2.pdf, retention-scenarios-2027.xlsx.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: OBS_PRICING_PKG_v2.pdf (pdf), retention-scenarios-2027.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons — need pricing scenarios for retention + tracing

Hannah — quick internal on concessions. I ran the aggressive numbers vs. forecasted utilization. Two recommendations:

1) Commit floor: require BrightPet to commit to a 12-month minimum spend of $120k ARR on addons for the 20% bundle discount to apply. That protects margin if usage spikes less than forecast.

2) Seat swap policy: approve view-only seats at $20/seat/mo if customer commits to 12 months and keeps at least 6 editor seats across org. Without commit, view-only should be $30/seat/mo.

If we accept a 6-month onboarding credit (capped at $12k) I want that tied to an early-termination clawback (prorated) in the SOW. Otherwise finance flags revenue leakage.

If Hannah is comfortable with those guardrails I can sign off. Rishi — quick thumbs up on final numbers/margin?

-Jordan

[internal note: attaching a redline to the pricing PDF before we send out - but not included in external email yet]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons — need pricing scenarios for retention + tracing

Jordan/JH — thumbs up on the guardrails. Margin check: aggressive path still lands us ~36% gross margin after the onboarding credit if they hit forecasted ingress. Approve view-only at $20/seat/mo under 12mo commit. Clawback language standard (prorated over remaining months) is fine.

I'll prepare the signed SOW template and DocuSign envelope; Hannah, tell me whether we should include a 30-day Net terms or Net30 with PO requirement. Procurement asked for Net30 + PO. Finance prefers PO + Net30 for enterprise.

-Rishi

[Attachment: signed-ma-sample.docx (docx) — template only]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@brightpet.com>, BrightPet Procurement <procurement@brightpet.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final proposal: BrightPet observability add-ons (conservative + aggressive options)

Hi Alyssa / procurement team — attaching the final package per your request. Key points and asks:

- Conservative path (no commitment): line items in the PDF.
- Aggressive path (12-month commit): 20% bundle discount on addons for 12 months, 6-month onboarding credit capped at $12,000, view-only seats at $20/seat/mo (requires 12mo commit and min 6 editor seats).
- Payment terms: PO + Net30 is acceptable. Onboarding credit applied as a credit memo across the first two invoices; early termination triggers prorated clawback as discussed.

Please review the attached OBS_PRICING_PKG_v2.pdf and the retention-scenarios-2027.xlsx. If the aggressive path works, reply here with confirmation and I will send the SOW via DocuSign (link below).

DocuSign SOW link: https://docusign.com/s/ABC123-redwood-brightpet-sow

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call if procurement wants to walk the numbers.

Best,
Hannah
